about.title: About Millas CPA & Associates
text: At Millas CPA & Associates we are well informed and updated with the constantly changing tax laws and regulations. Millas CPA provides personalized service to every client and takes advantage of tax laws and regulations that benefit the clients the most.

For the last 20 years we have been assisting our clients with several business related circumstances such as establishing an entity, buying a new business, selling an existing business, and understanding the tax consequences related to those choices.

Millas CPA & Assosiates provides affordable, reliable and timely payroll services. Unlike other payroll providing firms, we do not have any hidden charges for different steps of the payroll function and unforeseen difficulties.
